performed_via_github_app.name: Gemini Code Assist
performed_via_github_app.description:
**Accelerate code reviews and improve code quality**

Bring the power of [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com/) directly to GitHub, providing AI-powered code reviews on your pull requests, with automatic pull request summaries, ready-to-commit code suggestions and the ability to invoke Gemini for assistance at any point on the PR.

This app is only available for Google Cloud customers. Follow the [setup instructions](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/code-review/set-up-code-assist-github) to get started.

ProducerConfig now rejects duplicate resolved outputs and all resolved input/output overlap; materialization repeats the invariant before preparation and commit. The exact alias repro is rejected before provider/write with predecessor bytes unchanged. Focused suite: 16/16 PASS; KG-N0 golden: 8/8 PASS; scaling baseline: PASS. Ready for fresh exact-head re-review.

All independent and automated review blockers are resolved at exact head 0f421981101ddd4911ae80b6a6ab31115511081c, tree b3d5a30f6c346ba1e9feca2a48b04527ac74c90f. Six automated threads were individually answered and resolved. Focused future seam: 21/21 PASS; KG-N0 golden: 8/8 PASS including byte/mtime zero-write replay; scaling baseline: PASS; historical builders/artifacts/runtime validator modified: 0. Worktree is clean and local/remote heads match. ready_for_re_review.

Settled both fresh exact-head P1 custody findings at head `f7cc94daf2f0ff105d395a23f511c4504ad6a9e7`, tree `622f1b5255a665595459d90ce382f1145ed809de`.

- Provider construction now rejects undeclared filesystem discovery through forbidden builtins (including `open`, `__import__`, `globals`, `eval`, and `exec`), direct producer-root access, and reflective attributes. Regressions cover both builtin `open` and `Path.read_text` discovery before provider/build/output.
- Materialization now deterministically rebuilds from authenticated config/inputs/predecessor/provider and byte-compares the complete delta/projection/manifest packet before preparation. A fully coordinated delta + receipt + manifest rewrite is rejected with the predecessor and all existing outputs byte-unchanged.

Settled the three additional fresh-review P1 findings at exact head `6b336c7433ddb4a02a027563b4e460b233fd0981`, tree `398e97023ff06fb3a37c3d251736dbc315369a8e`.

- Capability isolation: the callback no longer receives `ProducerConfig`, `Path`, or configured paths. It receives a recursively immutable path-free `ProducerContext`, opaque-keyed authenticated input bytes/parsed documents, and a path-free predecessor view. The exact `context.__reduce__()[2][0]` escape shape cannot recover a path. The fixture now consumes its declared family source only through the authenticated payload; changing that source fails under the old receipt and changes config/output only after explicit receipt reconstruction.
- Cross-process determinism: unordered set construction is rejected by the callback contract, non-semantic QuestionPart/evidence collections are normalized, explicit ProcedureInstance/ProcedureStepInstance order is preserved, and complete packet hashes match under `PYTHONHASHSEED=1`, `7`, and `101`.
- Transactional local commit: all three outputs receive rollback copies before replacement. Injected second-output path drift after the first replacement restores every preexisting byte/mode, removes the previously absent output, leaves the predecessor unchanged, and removes temp/rollback files.
- The prior deterministic full-packet rebuild remains and rejects coordinated delta/receipt/manifest alteration before output preparation.

Verification at this exact head:

- future seam: 27/27 PASS
- #1765 golden compatibility: 8/8 PASS, including deterministic byte/mtime zero-write replay
- #1765 scaling baseline: PASS
- changed-file lint: PASS
- Python compile and `git diff --check`: PASS
- historical builders/artifacts/runtime validator modified: 0
- future predecessor global mutation: 0

Settled the latest rollback and same-process callback findings at exact head `36f85ec2b8af5e9665b1d6c5deefa1e5a0f2547b`, tree `5651bcf744e034239c252ded1279854195376cb2`.

- Provider authority boundary: same-process Python arguments are no longer claimed as a sandbox. `ProducerConfig` accepts only a provider identity/source path explicitly bound in the producer admission registry, and binds/revalidates that checked-in source file's exact SHA-256 and byte length before build and materialization. The exact traceback/caller-frame provider is rejected at config construction as outside the admitted identity.
- Reduced provider surface remains: the admitted provider receives only immutable context, opaque-keyed authenticated input bytes/documents, and the authenticated predecessor view. The fixture consumes its declared family source through that payload.
- Rollback obstruction: rollback now attempts every target independently and aggregates failures after all attempts. Recoverable prior bytes/modes are restored, previously absent outputs remain absent, the predecessor remains unchanged, and a backup blocked by a hostile directory is retained with its path/SHA-256/byte length reported. The normal symlink/failure rollback still leaves zero temp/rollback files.
- Cross-process determinism and deterministic full-packet rebuild protections remain intact.
